title: Note on the Habits of the Pampas Woodpecker
zh_title: 潘帕斯啄木鸟习性札记
author: Charles Darwin
edition: Proceedings of the Zoological Society of London, 1870, pp. 705–706; original body and two original notes, modern editorial notes excluded.

title: Vox Populi
author: Francis Galton
edition: Nature 75, pp. 450–451, 7 March 1907. All nine body paragraphs, original table and diagram. The direction of the quartile deviations in paragraph S005 contradicts the table; the historical wording is preserved.

title: Does the Inertia of a Body Depend upon its Energy-Content?
zh_title: 物体的惯性是否取决于它的能量含量？
author: Albert Einstein
edition: Original German paper, Annalen der Physik 18, 639–641 (1905); English translation in The Principle of Relativity (1923), W. Perrett and G. B. Jeffery. Full paper including six equations and original note. Fourmilab explicitly releases its derived edition to the public domain.

title: The Kite Experiment
author: Benjamin Franklin
edition: The Pennsylvania Gazette, 19 October 1752. Franklin’s complete six-paragraph statement only; later Priestley account and modern editorial introduction excluded.

title: Of Studies
author: Francis Bacon
edition: Complete essay in the expanded 1625 edition of Essays; text transcribed from the 1884 collected edition. Modern reading apparatus removed, original Latin retained and translated in context.

title: Of Truth
author: Francis Bacon
edition: Complete 1625 essay; text transcribed from the 1884 collected edition. Editorial annotation numbers and running page numbers excluded.

title: The Candlemakers’ Petition
author: Frédéric Bastiat
edition: Economic Sophisms, First Series, essay VII (1845), complete; Patrick James Stirling’s English translation, 1873. Obvious transcription errors com/corn and natural/national corrected.

title: Gettysburg Address
author: Abraham Lincoln
edition: Complete standard text inscribed on the Lincoln Memorial, transcribed by the Library of Congress; speech delivered 19 November 1863.

title: A Modest Proposal
author: Jonathan Swift
edition: Complete 1729 essay, 33 body paragraphs, with original subtitle. Project Gutenberg edition 1080; Gutenberg name and distribution wrapper excluded.

title: A Piece of Chalk
author: G. K. Chesterton
edition: Complete essay II in Tremendous Trifles (1909), nine body paragraphs. Preserve paragraph order, omit typographical dot separators.
